neighbours.label: the word ' chord' (as in a chord change or chord progression)
fire: In the bridge the guitarist slips in an unexpected minor chord before the final verse.
Beginners usually learn the G major chord in their first lesson.
The pianist held the last chord until the hall fell completely silent.
Most pop songs reuse the same four chords in a different order.
She wrote the lyrics first and only later found a chord progression to fit them.
The organist ended the hymn on a bright, ringing chord.
That jazz standard is famous for its rapid chord changes.
He tuned the strings and strummed an open chord to check them.
quiet: In the bridge the guitarist slips in an unexpected minor key before the final verse.
Beginners usually learn the G major scale in their first lesson.
The pianist held the last note until the hall fell completely silent.
Most pop songs reuse the same four bars in a different order.
She wrote the lyrics first and only later found a melody to fit them.
The organist ended the hymn on a bright, ringing tone.
That jazz standard is famous for its rapid key changes.
He tuned the strings and strummed a few notes to check them.

notes: Card top examples are mixed (induction loop, haplotype, plugs into, eig, chord, split brain). Probe: chord 0.60, the others 0.13-0.19, so only ' chord' reliably reaches threshold; the label is narrow and probably partial.
